purpose: Issue #52 source register. Only two kinds of record may appear: a COMPLETE owner-approved source package, and a source backed by a promoted SOURCE_CANDIDATE from Issue #53. Original sources are immutable for provenance: content_hash is recomputed from the file on every load and a mismatch is refused rather than re-derived.

sources.title: Unbudgeted AI and SaaS spend now needs a defensible number before renewal
allowed_claims: Publicly reported figures describe SaaS and AI subscription waste in the 25-30% range.
Publicly reported figures describe 78% of CFO and IT leaders encountering unbudgeted AI charges.
Organisations are reported to be moving to quarterly AI and SaaS spend audits.
The reducible-spend calculator published on stratumpraxis.com is free and requires no signup.

restricted_claims.safe_rewrite: There is no customer outcome to report. revenue-os/metrics.json records verified_revenue null.
State that the calculator produces an estimate from the reader's own inputs.
No external money evidence supports an external-consensus claim for this thesis.

sources.excerpt: Teams are accumulating unbudgeted AI and SaaS subscriptions, and someone now has to justify the total on a quarterly cycle. The buyer wants a defensible number before the next renewal, not a general automation pitch.
sources.notes: content_hash is a fixed placeholder digest because a candidate-derived source has no file on disk; lib/source.mjs only recomputes and enforces the hash for sources that name a source_file. The provenance guarantee for this record is the candidate store entry named in source_candidate_id, which lib/source.mjs verifies is promoted and unexpired on every load.

sources.title: Recurring checking behaviour, not article volume, is what makes a site durable
allowed_claims: Some widely used services are built on a recurring checking behaviour rather than on article volume.
The package names timeanddate.com, Flightradar24, StatusGator and Going as public examples of that pattern.
Rights, licensing and operator liability are given as reasons to avoid certain categories.

restricted_claims.phrase: i built a site like this
restricted_claims.safe_rewrite: The source argues a pattern; it does not record the operator building one of these services.
The examples are public services described from public information.

evidence_refs: content/note-publish-queue/README.md defines the COMPLETE criteria this package meets
sources.excerpt: Strong sites are not necessarily the ones with the most articles. Timetables, outage pages, fare checks and price changes create a reason to come back, and that recurring check is the asset.
